description.value: Databricks, Inc. is a private, San Francisco-based data and AI software company.
Databricks is a unified data and AI platform that runs both analytical and operational workloads.
A data and AI platform that runs analytical and operational workloads on one open, governed foundation.
A San Francisco-based data and AI company whose core product is a unified lakehouse platform for data management, engineering, warehousing, and AI.

product_description.value: Data + AI Platform, Lakebase (serverless Postgres integrated with the lakehouse), Genie (data-aware AI partner), Unity Gateway (governance for enterprise AI) and Lakehouse (serverless data warehousing on open lake data).

Data + AI Platform, Lakebase, Genie, Unity Gateway, Agent Bricks, Lakehouse, Lakeflow (batch and streaming ETL), AI/BI, Unity Catalog (governance), Databricks Apps, Security (Lakewatch), Sharing, Marketplace and Partner Connect.

A cloud lakehouse platform combining data warehouse and data lake features, built on Apache Spark. Key offerings include Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Mosaic AI tools, the DBRX open model, Agent Bricks, Lakebase, Genie, and Lakewatch.
Genie, Lakebase, Lakehouse, Lakeflow, Unity Catalog, Agent Bricks, Lakewatch and Databricks Apps.
A unified lakehouse platform for data management, engineering, warehousing and AI, built on Apache Spark and open-source projects such as Delta Lake, MLflow and Unity Catalog.

business_model_description.value: Pricing is organized around DBUs, with a separate compute cost calculator and a free entry point: "Get started with Databricks for free. No credit card required."
Revenue comes mainly from subscription and consumption-based pricing aligned with cloud service usage. A free community edition feeds leads to enterprise sales.

customer_description.value: Over 20,000 customers across the globe; over 60% of the Fortune 500 uses Databricks.

Over 20,000 customers globally; over 60% of the Fortune 500 uses Databricks. Industry focus areas include telecommunications, financial services, healthcare and life sciences, retail, manufacturing, media and entertainment, and the public sector.
More than 5,000 customers as of February 2021, the most recent customer count in the article.
The History section says the company reported more than 5,000 customers in February 2021.

Over 15,000 organizations globally, including more than 60% of the Fortune 500; customers span financial services, healthcare, retail and media. Another source says over 11,500 customers by June 2024.

revenue.value: $6.9 billion annualized (Jun 2026), up about 80% year over year

founded_year.value: Founded in 2013 out of UC Berkeley's AMPLab, the group behind Apache Spark.
